topic: POV: container of kids' toys held at customs; certificate data eFiled at entry
vo: Day 1: my first container of kids' toys hits the port.
Then customs. My broker: it's on hold, I need the certificate data.
I only have a lab report. Imported toys now need certificate data eFiled at entry.
So I build it: product, each rule, factory, lab, records contact.
Blocked right now? Forward the notice. Get your gap list in twenty-four hours.

caps: Say I'm a seller. My toys arrive in container KID-24-BLUE.
The truck stops at the gate.
Imported toys: certificate data eFiled at entry.
From my file, for the entry filing.

scenes.headline: Blocked right now?
scenes.line2: Get your gap list in 24 hours.

caption:
POV: your toys reach the port, and then the truck stops at customs.
For imported toys and other certified products, certificate data is now eFiled when the entry is filed (16 CFR 1110.13(a)(1)).
A lab report alone usually isn't the certificate. The data includes: product ID, each rule, who certifies, where and when it was made, the lab and test date, and a records contact.
Say a seller has only the lab report. That's the gap to close first.
Blocked right now? Forward the notice, gap list in 24h: link in bio

sources.claim: Imports: certificate data eFiled in ACE at entry
sources.quote: the finished product certifier must eFile the finished product certificate data elements required in § 1110.11 at the time of filing the entry, or the time of filing the entry and entry summary, if both are filed together, in ACE

sources.claim: Part 1110 (incl. the 1110.13 eFiling text) amended July 8, 2026; no later effective-date note
Each certificate carries a product identifier
sources.quote: Finished product certificates must contain at least one of the following unique identifiers: global trade item number (GTIN), model number, registered number, serial number, stock keeping number (SKU), universal product code (UPC), or alternate identifier
Finished product certificates must identify separately all applicable rules, bans, standards, or regulations.

sources.claim: Certificate data: records contact, manufacture, test date and lab
sources.quote: (4) Identify and provide contact information ... for the individual maintaining records ... (5) Provide the date (month and year, at a minimum) and place ... where the finished product(s) were manufactured ... (6) Provide the most recent date and place(s) (including for each third party conformity assessment body ...) where the finished product(s) were tested
